headline.en: Apollo's $26 Billion Private Credit Fund Faces Another Rush for Exits
headline.zh: Apollo 260 亿美元私募信贷基金再度遭遇退出潮

summary.en: Apollo's $26 billion private credit fund is facing another rush for exits, according to the headline. The article provides no further details on the nature or scale of the exit requests.
summary.zh: 据标题，Apollo 260 亿美元的私募信贷基金再度遭遇退出潮。文章未提供有关退出请求性质或规模的更多细节。

items.source_headline: Apollo’s $26 Billion Private Credit Fund Faces Another Rush for Exits
items.relevance_reason: Investor exit pressure at a large Apollo private credit fund can indicate redemption and liquidity conditions for the tracked manager's credit platform.
